_comment: Shared FNV-1a-based NBRKEY hash test vectors (T-model spec §3.2's 'Hash:' note). The same two-pass FNV-1a-32 algorithm (seed1=0x811c9dc5, seed2=0x9e3779b1, prime=0x01000193) is implemented independently in three places -- the topo.nbr.discovery LLD preprocessing script, the topo.nbr item prototype's select-by-NBRKEY script, and CTopologyTModel's PHP assembler (§5.4 peer-port resolution / NBRKEY recomputation for diagnostics). Each implementation must reproduce every vector below byte-for-byte; a mismatch means one of the three has drifted, not that the vectors are wrong.
